instances.description: Empty formula with zero variables.
instances.status_basis: The empty conjunction is true.

instances.description: Empty formula with four unused declared variables.
instances.status_basis: The empty conjunction is true for every assignment.

instances.description: One empty clause with zero variables.
instances.status_basis: An empty disjunction is false.

instances.description: One empty clause with unused declared variables.
instances.status_basis: The empty clause is false independently of all declared variables.

instances.description: A single positive unit clause.
instances.status_basis: Setting variable 1 to true satisfies the clause.

instances.description: A single negative unit clause.
instances.status_basis: Setting variable 1 to false satisfies the clause.

instances.description: Contradicting positive and negative units.
instances.status_basis: The two units require opposite values of variable 1.

instances.description: Repeated literals within clauses.
instances.status_basis: Setting variables 1 and 2 to true satisfies both clauses.

instances.description: One tautological clause.
instances.status_basis: The clause contains a literal and its negation, so every assignment satisfies it.

instances.description: Repeated clauses with an additional binary clause.
instances.status_basis: Setting variable 2 to true satisfies all clauses.

instances.description: Repeated empty clauses with zero variables.
instances.status_basis: Either empty clause alone is false.

instances.description: A tautology alongside contradicting units.
instances.status_basis: The tautology does not resolve the opposing requirements on variable 2.

instances.description: All variables occur only positively.
instances.status_basis: Setting every variable to true satisfies all clauses.

instances.description: All variables occur only negatively.
instances.status_basis: Setting every variable to false satisfies all clauses.

instances.description: Sparse numbering reaches declared variable 1024.
instances.status_basis: Setting variable 1024 to true satisfies both clauses; other variables are unconstrained.

instances.description: Contradicting units at the declared maximum variable.
instances.status_basis: The units require opposite values of variable 1024.

instances.description: Sparse interior and maximum variables leave large numbering gaps.
instances.status_basis: Variable 2 true, variable 513 false, and variable 1024 false satisfy all clauses.

instances.description: A 128-literal clause is satisfied only at its last literal after unit propagation.
instances.status_basis: Variables 1 through 127 are false and variable 128 is true.

instances.description: A 128-literal clause conflicts after every literal is forced false.
instances.status_basis: All literals of the long clause are falsified by negative units.

instances.description: A positive unit propagates through 31 binary implications.
instances.status_basis: Setting all variables to true satisfies the initial unit and every implication.

instances.description: A binary implication chain ends in a contradicting unit.
instances.status_basis: The initial unit and implications force variable 32 true, contradicting its negative unit.

instances.description: A long clause has its first fourteen literals forced false and its last true.
instances.status_basis: Variable 16 true satisfies the long clause; variables 1 through 14 are false.

instances.description: A long clause is exhausted by sixteen negative unit assignments.
instances.status_basis: Every literal of the long clause is forced false.

instances.description: A binary implication cycle is seeded by a positive unit.
instances.status_basis: Setting all three variables to true satisfies the cycle and the unit.

instances.description: All four binary clauses over two variables exclude every assignment.
instances.status_basis: For each assignment, the clause containing both falsified literals is false.

instances.description: Multiple comment lines precede the DIMACS header.
instances.status_basis: Setting both variables to true satisfies the two clauses.

instances.description: Blank lines, leading spaces, and tabs separate legal tokens.
instances.status_basis: Variables 1 and 2 true and variable 3 false satisfy all clauses.

instances.description: Both clauses span physical lines before their zero terminators.
instances.status_basis: Variables 1 and 3 true satisfy the first clause by 1 and the second by 3.

instances.description: Unit literals and their zero terminators occupy separate lines.
instances.status_basis: The two unit clauses require opposite values of variable 1.

instances.description: Three complete clauses share a single physical line.
instances.status_basis: Setting both variables to true satisfies all three clauses.

instances.description: The last clause terminator is followed immediately by end of file.
instances.status_basis: The two unit clauses require opposite values of variable 1.

instances.description: Every physical line uses CRLF line endings.
instances.status_basis: Variable 1 true and variable 2 false satisfy both clauses.
